name: OS
series_name: DSSSB TGT CS — OS Complete (Notes + 200 Most Expected)
series_name_hi: DSSSB TGT CS — ऑपरेटिंग सिस्टम सम्पूर्ण
series_description: Operating Systems from basics to exam level, including the Linux commands DSSSB asks heavily: previous-year questions, chapter-wise practice with scheduling, page-replacement and disk numericals, and the 200 most expected questions with solutions. Notes and a fast-revision sheet are in Courses → DSSSB TGT Computer Science → OS.
tagline: OS structure & system calls · processes & threads · CPU scheduling · synchronisation & deadlocks · memory & virtual memory · file systems & disk · Linux commands
intro: In the 4 official DSSSB TGT Computer Science papers of 2023–24 there were {n} OS questions, about 8 per paper — and an analysis of 12 papers ranks OS as the most-asked CS area. Thirteen of them are on Linux (grep, chmod, rm, permissions, shells, the $ prompt, /etc), so the Linux chapter is a must. The rest follow Silberschatz–Galvin: system calls, process states, dispatcher, semaphores, deadlock conditions, page faults, Belady's anomaly, file systems and disk scheduling. Start with the fast-revision sheet.
